name: KONG Classic Dog Toy
description: The red rubber chew that’s been in toy boxes for decades. It bounces in odd directions for fetch, and the hollow middle takes peanut butter, kibble or a smear of pumpkin, so it doubles as a slow treat puzzle. Freeze it stuffed for a longer-lasting chew.
details: Sizes: Small (dogs up to 9 kg) and Medium (7 to 16 kg)
Stuff with treats or spreads; freeze for longer chewing

name: KONG Wild Knots Bear
description: A soft plush bear with a knotted rope skeleton inside, so it holds up to tugging and shaking longer than a regular stuffed toy. Minimal stuffing means less mess if it does get opened up.
details: Plush outer with internal knotted rope
Not a chew toy; supervise play

name: Chuckit! Ultra Ball, 2 Pack
description: High-bounce rubber balls in bright orange and blue that are easy to spot in the grass and float in water. The thick rubber stands up to rough fetch better than tennis balls, and they rinse clean.
details: Medium size, 6.4 cm, fits Chuckit! launchers

name: Chuckit! Classic Ball Launcher
description: Throw farther without the slobbery hands. The launcher scoops the ball off the ground and flings it two or three times as far as an arm can, which tires out even the most dedicated fetcher. Comes with one ball.

name: Benebone Wishbone Chew, Bacon
description: A wishbone-shaped chew made for dogs who mean it. The three-legged shape lifts one end off the floor so paws can hold it in place, and real bacon flavour is baked right in. Made in the USA.
details: Small (for dogs up to 14 kg) or Medium
Replace when worn down or rough

name: Nylabone Power Chew Textured Bone
description: A long-lasting bone with raised bristles that help scrub teeth as your dog chews. Good for strong chewers who go through softer toys in an afternoon.
details: Regular size for dogs up to 11 kg
Replace when knuckles are worn down

name: Lamb Chop Plush Toy
description: The fluffy white lamb with the big eyelashes, a favourite of small dogs everywhere. It squeaks, it’s soft enough to carry around and nap with, and it’s the right size for little mouths.

name: ZippyPaws Skinny Peltz No-Stuffing Toys, 3 Pack
description: Three flat woodland friends, a fox, a raccoon and a squirrel, with no stuffing to pull out and squeakers in the head and tail. Perfect for dogs who love to shake and “kill” their toys.

name: Outward Hound Hide-A-Squirrel Puzzle
description: A plush tree trunk with three squeaky squirrels hiding inside. Your dog gets to dig them out, which scratches the same itch that sends dachshunds into gopher holes. Refill and repeat.

name: Nina Ottosson Dog Brick Puzzle
description: A treat puzzle with sliding blocks and flip-up lids. Hide treats in the compartments and let your dog work out how to reach them. Ten minutes of puzzle time is as tiring as a long walk.

name: GoDog Dragon with Chew Guard
description: A goofy plush dragon with Chew Guard lining that makes it tougher than a regular stuffed toy. Squeakers inside keep it interesting.

name: West Paw Zogoflex Tux Treat Toy
description: A bouncy, chew-resistant treat toy with a deep pocket for stuffing. Squeeze in treats and watch your dog work them out. It floats, it’s recyclable, and West Paw replaces it once if your dog chews through it.
details: Zogoflex material, BPA and latex free

name: Frank the Dapple Plush
description: Our mascot in squeaky form: a long, low dachshund plush with a soft dapple coat of chocolate and silver spots. He has a squeaker in his belly and a crinkle tail, and he’s exactly the size a little dog likes to carry around.
details: Plush with squeaker and crinkle tail

name: Long Dog Rope Tug
description: A thick braided cotton rope in our chocolate, tan and cream dapple colours, with knots at each end for tug and fetch. Chewing on the strands helps floss teeth.
details: Replace if strands start to come loose

name: Petstages Dogwood Stick
description: All the fun of a stick without the splinters. It has a real wood scent dogs love and is made from wood fibre and synthetic material that won’t shatter in their mouth.
details: Made in part from real wood

name: JW Hol-ee Roller Ball
description: A stretchy rubber ball full of holes. Toss it, tug it, or stuff a soft toy or treats inside for a quick puzzle.

name: Greenies Original Dental Treats, Teenie
description: The toothbrush-shaped dental chew that many vets recommend. The chewy texture scrubs away plaque and tartar while your dog enjoys a treat, and Teenie size is right for small dogs from 2 to 7 kg.
details: Teenie size, for dogs 2 to 7 kg

name: Milk-Bone Original Biscuits, Small
description: The classic crunchy bone-shaped biscuit. Crunchy texture helps reduce tartar build-up, and small biscuits are sized for small and medium dogs.
details: Small biscuits for dogs 9 to 22 kg
Feed as a treat alongside a complete diet

name: Zuke’s Mini Naturals Peanut Butter Training Treats
description: Tiny, soft training treats that are easy to break and quick to eat, so training keeps moving. Under 3 calories each, so you can reward often.
details: Made without corn, wheat or soy

name: Blue Bits Soft-Moist Training Treats, Salmon
description: Soft, salmon-flavoured training bites with DHA. Small enough to hand out by the dozen during a training session.
details: Real salmon is the first ingredient
No chicken or poultry by-product meals

name: Old Mother Hubbard P-Nuttier Biscuits, Mini
description: Oven-baked crunchy biscuits made with peanut butter and baked slowly for real crunch. Minis are the right size for small dogs and training.

name: Crumps’ Naturals Sweet Potato Chews
description: Slices of sweet potato, slowly dried until chewy. One ingredient, made in Canada, and a good pick for dogs with sensitive tummies.

name: Bocce’s Bakery Pumpkin Pie Biscuits
description: Crunchy little biscuits that smell like fall: pumpkin, cinnamon and ginger, made with a short list of ingredients. A seasonal favourite.

name: Bully Sticks, 6 Inch, 5 Pack
description: Single-ingredient beef chews that keep dogs busy and help scrape teeth clean as they gnaw. Our 6 inch size suits small and medium dogs. Low odour.
details: Supervise chewing; take away the last small piece

name: Himalayan Yak Cheese Chew, Small
description: A rock-hard chew made from yak and cow milk, a recipe from the Himalayas. It softens slowly as your dog chews, and when it gets small, microwave it into a puffy crunchy treat.
details: Yak and cow milk, salt, lime juice
Microwave the end piece to puff it

name: Pupcake Birthday Biscuit Box
description: A gift box of hand-iced vanilla and carob biscuits in birthday shapes: bones, balloons, paw prints and little long dogs. Dog-safe yogurt icing, no chocolate, no xylitol.

name: Puppy Cake Wheat-Free Cake Mix, Peanut Butter
description: A birthday cake mix made for dogs. Add water, an egg and oil, bake for 25 minutes, then top it with the frosting mix that comes in the box.

name: PetSafe Easy Walk Harness
description: The front-clip harness trainers reach for with pullers. The leash attaches at the chest, so when your dog pulls they get turned gently back toward you instead of dragging you down the street.
details: Quick-snap buckles on the shoulder and belly

name: Puppia Soft Vest Harness
description: A soft, padded vest harness that spreads pressure across the chest instead of the neck. A good everyday pick for dachshunds, whose necks and backs do better without collar pressure.

name: Kurgo Journey Air Harness
description: A lightweight, breathable harness with both front and back leash clips and reflective trim for evening walks.

name: Ruffwear Front Range Harness
description: A padded harness built for all-day adventures, with a front clip for training, a back clip for easy walking and an ID pocket. Easy on, easy off.

name: Flexi Classic Retractable Leash, 5 m
description: Give your dog room to sniff in the park while staying in control. The cord reels out up to 5 metres and locks with one thumb.
details: 5 m cord, for dogs up to 12 kg
Use on open paths, not near roads

name: Dapple Print Collar
description: Our signature collar in a soft nylon webbing printed with our dapple spot pattern: chocolate, tan and silver on cream. Brushed brass hardware and a sturdy D-ring for tags.

name: Dapple Print Leash, 6 ft
description: The matching leash to our collar, in the same dapple spot webbing, with a padded handle and brushed brass clip.

name: Nite Ize NiteHowl LED Safety Necklace
description: A glowing ring that slips over your dog’s collar so cars and cyclists can see them on dark evening walks. Steady glow or flashing, visible from far away.

name: Brass Bone ID Tag, Engraved
description: A solid brass bone-shaped tag engraved with your dog’s name and your phone number. Add the details in the gift note at checkout and we’ll engrave it before it ships.
details: Put the name and phone in the order note

name: Best Friends by Sheri Calming Donut Bed
description: A round, shaggy faux-fur bed with a raised rim that dogs can curl into and rest their head on. Many owners say anxious dogs settle faster in it.

name: Burrow Cave Bed
description: Dachshunds were bred to go underground, and most still want to. This bed has a soft hooded cover so they can tunnel in and hide, a supportive bolster for their chin and a cozy sherpa lining.
details: Sherpa lining, quilted outer in chocolate

name: K&H Self-Warming Pet Pad
description: A layer inside reflects your dog’s own body heat back to them, so this pad feels warm with no plug and no electricity. Ideal for crates, cars and chilly floors.

name: Sherpa Snuggle Blanket
description: A soft blanket with a dapple-print fleece side and a cream sherpa side, sized for a small dog to burrow under on the couch.

name: Pet Gear Easy Step Pet Stairs
description: Dachshunds have long backs and short legs, and jumping on and off furniture is one of the most common causes of back injury. These carpeted stairs let them reach the couch or bed safely.

name: Outward Hound Fun Feeder Slo Bowl
description: A maze bowl that slows gulpers down so mealtime lasts several minutes instead of seconds, which helps with bloating and vomiting.

name: Spotted Stoneware Bowl
description: A heavy stoneware bowl in a cream glaze with hand-sponged chocolate and silver spots, so no two are alike. Heavy enough that it doesn’t slide around the floor.

name: PetSafe Drinkwell Platinum Fountain
description: Moving, filtered water that tempts dogs to drink more. A free-falling stream adds oxygen, and a carbon filter catches hair and odours.

name: LickiMat Classic Buddy
description: Spread on yogurt, pumpkin or wet treats and let your dog lick it off the textured surface. Licking is calming, so it’s great for baths, nail trims and thunderstorms.

name: Long Dog Cable Knit Sweater
description: Most sweaters fit a dachshund like a crop top. Ours is cut longer through the body and roomier in the chest, so it covers the back, stays put and keeps a short-coated dog warm on cold walks.
details: Sizes S to L, with a size guide in the details
Hand wash, lay flat to dry

name: Canada Pooch Waterproof Dog Raincoat
description: A waterproof shell with a soft lining that keeps your dog dry on wet walks. A rear leash opening lets you clip on a harness underneath.

name: Pawz Disposable Rubber Dog Boots, 12 Pack
description: Thin natural rubber boots that keep road salt, snow and ice off paws through the Canadian winter. Dogs feel the ground through them, so most adapt quickly.

name: Spotted Bandana
description: A soft cotton bandana in our dapple spot print, with snaps so it stays on without tying. Photo-ready.

name: Howliday Plaid Pajamas
description: Soft flannel pajamas in red and green plaid for holiday photos and lazy winter mornings. Cut long through the body for dachshunds and other low riders.

name: FURminator Undercoat deShedding Tool, Small
description: A stainless steel edge reaches through the topcoat to pull out loose undercoat before it ends up on your couch. A button pops the hair off the blade.
details: Use 10 to 20 minutes, once or twice a week

name: Burt’s Bees Oatmeal Shampoo for Dogs
description: A gentle oatmeal and honey shampoo that cleans without drying out the skin. pH balanced for dogs.

name: Earthbath Hypo-Allergenic Grooming Wipes
description: Fragrance-free wipes for muddy paws, faces and quick clean-ups between baths. Gentle enough for sensitive skin.

name: Safari Professional Nail Trimmer, Small
description: Sharp stainless steel blades and a safety stop make for clean, quick nail trims at home.

name: Virbac C.E.T. Enzymatic Toothpaste, Poultry
description: A poultry-flavoured enzymatic toothpaste that dogs actually like. Small breeds like dachshunds are prone to dental disease, so brushing a few times a week matters.

name: Earth Rated Poop Bags, 120 Count
description: Thick, leak-proof bags that tear off cleanly and open on the first try. Lavender-scented. Earth Rated started in Montreal.

name: Sherpa Original Deluxe Pet Carrier, Small
description: A soft-sided carrier that fits under most airline seats, with mesh panels for airflow and a padded shoulder strap. Fits most mini dachshunds.

name: Kurgo Skybox Booster Seat
description: Lifts small dogs up high enough to see out the window, which helps with car anxiety, and keeps them in one place with a tether.

name: Outward Hound Granby Life Jacket
description: Dachshunds are not natural swimmers. This life jacket keeps them floating with a top rescue handle so you can lift them out of the water.

name: Walkies Treat Pouch
description: A clip-on treat pouch for training walks, with a magnetic closure that opens with one hand and a back pocket for poop bags and keys.

name: KONG Extreme Dog Toy
description: The black version of the classic KONG, made from KONG’s toughest rubber for dogs who make short work of everything else. Same unpredictable bounce, same hollow middle for stuffing, just a lot harder to wreck.
details: Sizes: Small (up to 9 kg) and Medium (7 to 16 kg)
Stuff with treats or spreads; freeze for longer chewing

name: KONG Puppy Toy
description: A softer rubber KONG made for baby teeth and sore gums. Stuff it with a little puppy food and freeze it for teething relief, or use it to keep a new pup busy in the crate.
details: Softer rubber formula for puppy teeth
Small size for puppies up to 9 kg
Replace with an adult KONG at about 9 months

name: KONG Wobbler Treat Dispenser
description: A weighted, egg-shaped treat dispenser that wobbles and rolls when nudged, dropping kibble or small treats out of a hole as it goes. Unscrew the top to fill it. Handy for slowing down fast eaters at mealtime.
details: Small size for dogs up to 11 kg
Fill with kibble or small treats

name: Busy Buddy Twist ’n Treat
description: Two rubber halves screw together around treats. Tighten it for a tougher challenge or loosen it so treats fall out more easily. A nice step up for dogs who have figured out their KONG.
details: Small size for dogs 9 to 18 kg

name: Busy Buddy Squirrel Dude
description: A squirrel-shaped rubber treat toy with flexible fingers inside the opening. Treats go in easily and come out slowly as your dog chews and rolls it around.
details: Natural rubber with interior treat fingers
Small size for dogs 4.5 to 9 kg
Works with kibble or treat rings

name: Busy Buddy Barnacle
description: A spiky-looking rubber ball with three openings of different sizes, so you can mix big and small treats for a puzzle that takes a while to empty. It bounces, rolls and wobbles.
details: Medium size for dogs 9 to 27 kg

name: Starmark Bob-A-Lot Treat Dispenser
description: A weighted, wobbling treat dispenser with adjustable openings. Your dog knocks it around to get kibble out, which turns dinner into a game and keeps gulpers from eating too fast.
details: Holds up to 3 cups of kibble (large)

name: Planet Dog Orbee-Tuff Ball
description: A minty-scented, glossy ball that bounces, floats and stands up to serious chomping. The hollow centre can hold a treat for extra motivation.
details: Orbee-Tuff material, BPA and phthalate free

name: Planet Dog Orbee-Tuff Snoop
description: A treat-dispensing ball with a single round opening and flexible inner flaps. Drop in kibble or a few treats and your dog has to roll and nose it just right to get them out.
details: Orbee-Tuff material, BPA and phthalate free

name: Nina Ottosson Dog Smart Puzzle
description: The easiest Nina Ottosson puzzle and a great first one for small dogs. Nine little cups cover treat wells, and your dog learns to nose or paw them off. Most dogs solve it the first day and want to do it again.

name: Nina Ottosson Dog Tornado Puzzle
description: Four stacked, rotating layers with treat compartments in each. Your dog spins the layers to uncover treats, and you can add bone-shaped blockers to make it harder.

name: Nina Ottosson Dog Twister Puzzle
description: The challenge level. Dogs have to slide blocks around a track and lift bone pegs out before they can reach the treats. Best for clever dogs who have already beaten level 1 and 2 puzzles.
details: Sliding blocks and lift-out bone pegs

name: Outward Hound Snuffle Mat
description: A fleece mat with layers of fabric strips to hide kibble and treats in. Sniffing them out is calming and surprisingly tiring, and it’s perfect for nose-down hounds like dachshunds and beagles.
details: Polar fleece strips on a non-slip base

name: Fluff & Tuff Nelly Elephant
description: A sweet grey plush elephant with double-stitched seams and a mesh liner, so it lasts longer than most stuffed toys. Soft enough to cuddle, sturdy enough for a good shake.

name: ZippyPaws Burrow Hedgehog Den
description: A plush log with three squeaky hedgehogs tucked inside. Your dog digs them out one by one, which is exactly the kind of job a burrowing dog was bred for. Stuff them back in and go again.
details: Small hedgehogs sized for little mouths

name: ZippyPaws Burrow Bee Hive
description: A yellow plush hive with three squeaky bees hiding in it. A hide-and-seek toy that gives small dogs something to dig, pull and carry off in triumph.

name: KONG Cozie Marvin the Moose
description: A soft, cuddly moose with an extra layer of material inside for a bit more toughness. The small size is perfect for little dogs who like to carry their toys from room to room.

name: Multipet Loofa Dog, 12 Inch
description: The long, floppy, squeaky dog that dogs have been carrying around for years. At 12 inches it’s just right for small breeds, and it’s cheap enough to keep a spare in the car.

name: Tuffy Ultimate Ring
description: A soft-sided ring made with several layers of tough fabric and reinforced seams, rated high on Tuffy’s toughness scale. Great for tug, fetch and floating in the pool.

name: GoDog Gator with Chew Guard
description: A friendly plush alligator with Chew Guard lining stitched inside, so it holds up better to rough play than an ordinary stuffed toy. Two squeakers keep it fun.

name: Outward Hound Invincibles Snake
description: A no-stuffing plush snake packed with squeakers that keep squeaking even if one gets punctured. Long enough for two dogs to play tug.

name: KONG Squeakair Tennis Balls, Small, 6 Pack
description: Tennis balls made for dogs, with a non-abrasive felt that’s gentler on teeth and a squeaker inside. The small size fits little mouths that can’t manage a regular ball.

name: Chuckit! Kick Fetch Ball
description: A big, grippy ball you can kick across the yard. Recessed grooves make it easy for dogs to pick up, and the bright colours stand out in the grass. Great for dogs too big or too bouncy for a launcher.

name: Chuckit! Flying Squirrel
description: A soft, floppy flyer with four stretched-out legs and a tail. It flies like a disc but is easy for dogs to grab mid-air and gentle on mouths, and it floats for water fetch.

name: Chuckit! Indoor Ball
description: A soft, lightweight ball made for fetch in the house. It rolls and bounces gently without knocking things off tables, and it’s easy on small jaws.

name: Jolly Pets Romp-n-Roll Ball
description: A bouncy, tough ball with a rope through the middle for tug, swinging and fetch. It stays inflated even if punctured and floats in the pool or lake.

name: Hartz Dura Play Ball
description: A lightweight latex ball filled with bacon-scented foam that floats and squeaks. Soft enough for small dogs and puppies, and easy on the budget.

name: Mammoth Flossy Chews 3-Knot Rope Tug
description: A colourful cotton-poly rope with three knots for tug, toss and chewing. The fibres help floss teeth while your dog plays.
details: Replace when strands start to come loose

name: Nylabone Puppy Chew Teething Keys
description: A ring of textured key-shaped chews, softer than adult Nylabones, for puppies working through the teething stage. Freeze it for a cool chew on sore gums.
details: Can be chilled in the freezer

name: Nylabone DuraChew Double Bone
description: A double-ended bone with knuckles at each end for strong chewers. The bristles raised as your dog chews help clean teeth.
details: Regular size for dogs up to 11 kg
Replace when knuckles are worn down

name: Benebone Dental Chew, Bacon
description: A curved chew with deep grooves and ridges that help scrape teeth while your dog gnaws. The curved shape is easy for paws to hold, and real bacon is in the nylon.
details: Small size for dogs up to 14 kg
Made in the USA; supervise chewing

name: Benebone Maplestick
description: Shaped like a stick and made with real maple wood, so it smells like the outdoors without splintering. A good swap for the dog who brings sticks inside.
details: Small size for dogs up to 14 kg

name: West Paw Zogoflex Hurley
description: A bone-shaped chew that’s bouncy, buoyant and easy on teeth. It holds up to a lot of chewing, and West Paw replaces it once if your dog chews through it.
details: Zogoflex material, BPA and latex free

name: West Paw Zogoflex Jive Ball, Mini
description: A small, bouncy, rounded ball with dimples that make it hop in fun directions. The mini size is made for small dogs, and it floats and is easy to clean.
details: Zogoflex material, BPA and latex free

name: Petstages Cool Teething Stick
description: A soft teething stick you freeze before giving, so it cools and soothes sore puppy gums. The raised nubs massage gums as they chew.

name: Pet Qwerks Talking Babble Ball
description: A motion-activated ball that talks, giggles and makes animal sounds when your dog nudges it. Good for keeping a curious dog busy when you’re not on the floor playing.

name: Pet Qwerks BarkBone Nylon Bone, Bacon
description: A flavour-infused nylon bone for strong chewers, with ridges that help clean teeth. Bacon flavour runs all the way through, so it stays interesting as it wears.
details: Small size for dogs up to 14 kg

name: KONG Holiday Classic
description: The classic KONG in a festive red with a snowflake pattern. Stuff it with a holiday treat or peanut butter and freeze it to keep your dog busy while the turkey cooks.
details: Small size for dogs up to 9 kg

name: P.L.A.Y. Merry Woofmas Santa’s Cookies
description: A plush plate of milk and cookies for Santa, with three small squeaky cookies to pull off and carry around. Chew Guard lining and recycled stuffing make it sturdy and better for the planet.

name: P.L.A.Y. Merry Woofmas Hot Cocoa
description: A cozy plush mug of hot cocoa topped with a marshmallow, with a squeaker and crinkle inside. It’s a cute stocking stuffer and a great holiday photo prop.

name: ZippyPaws Holiday Burrow, Christmas Stocking
description: A plush red stocking with three squeaky toys tucked inside, ready for your dog to dig out on Christmas morning. A favourite with dachshunds and other little burrowers.
details: Small toys sized for little mouths

name: Multipet Holiday Loofa Dog
description: The classic floppy Loofa Dog dressed for the season in red and green with a little holiday hat. Squeaky, lightweight and just the right size for small dogs.

name: Greenies Blueberry Dental Treats, Teenie
description: The same toothbrush-shaped dental chew as the original, with blueberry flavour for dogs who like a change. The chewy texture works against plaque and tartar, and Teenie size suits small dogs from 2 to 7 kg.
details: Teenie size, for dogs 2 to 7 kg

name: Whimzees Natural Dental Chews, Small, 28 Count
description: Vegetable-based dental chews shaped with ridges and knobbly bits that reach between teeth. They contain no meat, gluten or artificial colours, which helps dogs with touchy stomachs. A month of chews for a small dog in one bag.
details: Made from potato starch and vegetable ingredients
Small size, for dogs 7 to 12 kg

name: Purina DentaLife Daily Oral Care Mini Chews, 40 Count
description: Porous, chewy sticks with ridges that help clean down to the gumline. Mini size is right for toy and small breeds, and a daily chew is an easy habit to keep between brushings.
details: Mini size, for dogs 2.5 to 9 kg

name: Milk-Bone Brushing Chews, Mini, 25 Count
description: A twisty, nubbed dental chew that cleans as your dog works through it. It’s a soft enough chew for small mouths and a good daily option for dogs who won’t sit for a toothbrush.
details: Mini size, for dogs 2 to 11 kg

name: Virbac C.E.T. VeggieDent FR3SH Chews, Extra Small, 30 Count
description: A vegetable-based Z-shaped chew from the same team behind C.E.T. toothpaste. The shape bends to reach back teeth, and it’s often the chew vets suggest for small dogs prone to tartar.
details: Extra Small size, for dogs under 5 kg

name: Zuke’s Mini Naturals Salmon Training Treats
description: Soft, tiny salmon treats that break easily and go down quickly, so training sessions keep moving. Each one is under 3 calories, which matters for small, long-backed dogs who need to stay trim.
details: Real salmon is the first ingredient
Soft and moist; reseal after opening

name: Wellness Soft Puppy Bites, Lamb & Salmon
description: Soft, grain-free bites made for puppy teeth and puppy attention spans. They include DHA from salmon oil, and they’re easy to tear into smaller pieces for little mouths.
details: Grain-free recipe with lamb and salmon

name: Fruitables Skinny Minis Pumpkin & Berry Chewy Treats
description: Soft little treats made with pumpkin and berries, at about 3 calories each. They’re a good fit for frequent rewards without blowing a small dog’s daily calories.

name: Cloud Star Tricky Trainers Chewy Liver Treats
description: Tiny chewy liver treats with a strong smell dogs notice, which helps in distracting places like the park. At around 1.5 calories each, you can hand out a lot of them.

name: Pet Botanics Training Reward Bacon Treats
description: Small, soft bacon-flavoured rewards that are easy to break up even smaller. A popular choice in obedience classes because they’re cheap per treat and don’t crumble in a pocket.
details: Soft and moist; reseal after opening

name: Purina Beggin’ Strips Bacon Flavour, 170 g
description: The bacon-style strips dogs go silly for. They tear easily, so you can split one into pieces for a small dog and make the bag go further.
details: Tear into smaller pieces for small dogs
Feed as a treat alongside a complete diet

name: Pup-Peroni Original Beef Sticks, 158 g
description: Soft, chewy beef sticks that slice cleanly with kitchen scissors into bite-sized rewards. They smell strong, which is the point, and they stay soft in a treat pouch.
details: Real beef is the first ingredient
Cut into smaller pieces for small dogs

name: Blue Buffalo Wilderness Trail Treats, Chicken
description: Crunchy, grain-free biscuits made with chicken and no corn, wheat or soy. They snap easily, so half a biscuit makes a good reward for a small dog.
details: Snap in half for small dogs

name: Stella & Chewy’s Just Breast Freeze-Dried Chicken Treats
description: Single-ingredient chicken breast, freeze-dried into light, crumbly pieces. Good for dogs on limited diets, and easy to break up for training.
details: Break into smaller pieces as needed

name: ORIJEN Freeze-Dried Treats, Original
description: Freeze-dried chicken, turkey and fish formed into small squares, with no fillers. They’re rich, so a few pieces go a long way, and they crumble nicely over a puzzle toy.
details: Break into pieces for small dogs

name: ACANA Singles Freeze-Dried Treats, Beef Liver
description: One protein, freeze-dried into crunchy bites with nothing else added. Liver is a high-value reward, so save it for recall practice and other big wins.
details: Very rich; feed in small amounts

name: Open Farm Dehydrated Grass-Fed Beef Treats
description: Gently dehydrated beef pieces from a brand that publishes where its ingredients come from. Chewy rather than crumbly, so they last a little longer than freeze-dried treats.
details: Tear into smaller pieces for small dogs

name: Northwest Naturals Freeze-Dried Chicken Breast Treats
description: Plain chicken breast, freeze-dried in small chunks. A simple, high-protein reward for picky dogs or ones that need to avoid grains and additives.
details: Rehydrate with water for older dogs if you like

name: Crumps’ Naturals Mini Trainers, Beef Liver
description: Freeze-dried beef liver cut into tiny cubes, made in Canada by Crumps’. Each piece is small enough for a dachshund-sized mouth, with no need to break anything up.
details: Tiny cubes for small dogs and training

name: Granville Island Pet Treatery Wild Salmon Bites
description: Made in Vancouver from wild Pacific salmon, dried into small crunchy bites. A good option for dogs with chicken or beef sensitivities.

name: Oven-Baked Tradition Peanut Butter Biscuits, Small
description: Crunchy biscuits baked in small batches in Quebec, with peanut butter and simple ingredients. The small size is easy to give whole to small dogs.

name: Benny Bully’s Liver Chops, 58 g
description: Pure Canadian beef liver, freeze-dried into crumbly chops that dogs will do just about anything for. Break them into crumbs for tiny dogs or sprinkle over a lick mat.

name: Northern Biscuit Peanut Butter Dog Biscuits
description: Crunchy biscuits from a Canadian bakery, made with peanut butter and a short ingredient list. They have a satisfying snap that dogs seem to enjoy.
details: Snap in half for small dogs

name: NOW FRESH Grain-Free Crunchy Treats, Turkey
description: Crunchy turkey treats from Petcurean, the Canadian maker based in BC. They’re grain-free and sized small enough to share easily.

name: Redbarn Bully Sticks, 7 Inch, 3 Pack
description: Single-ingredient beef bully sticks that soften as they’re chewed. A 7 inch stick keeps a small dog busy for a good while; take it away once it’s short enough to swallow.
details: Remove when small enough to swallow
